blocks.text: Nitric oxide aur nitrogen dioxide ko NOx se zahir kiya jata hai. Yeh aam taur par fossil fuels jalne se paida hote hain: zyada darja hararat par N2 + O2 se 2NO (nitric oxide), aur 2NO + O2 se 2NO2 (nitrogen dioxide). N2O ke qudrati zaraye mitti aur samandar ke microbial amal hain jahan bacteria nitrogen compounds torte hain; insani zaraye mein zaraat (masnooi fertilisers) aur sanati amal (fossil fuels ka jalna) shamil hain. N2O ozone ki tah ghatati hai, aur barhi hui N2O climate change mein hissa dalti aur hawa ke mayar par asar dalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fuel jalana nitrogen oxides kyun paida karta hai halanke fuels mein nitrogen kam hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jalne ka zyada darja hararat khud hawa ki nitrogen aur oxygen ko milata hai, N2 + O2 se 2NO, aur nitric oxide phir exhaust aur hawa mein nitrogen dioxide mein oxidise hoti hai.

items: NOx = NO + NO2 fuel jalne se (zyada darja hararat par N2 + O2 se 2NO; 2NO + O2 se 2NO2); microbes, fertilisers aur jalne se N2O ozone ghatati aur climate garam karti hai.
